remarks:
Priced to sell and full of potential, this spacious two-family home presents an excellent opportunity for an investor or owner-occupant ready to add value. Each unit features a large eat-in kitchen with a walk-in pantry, along with a separate formal dining room providing plenty of space for everyday living and entertaining. A spacious attic adds valuable additional space for storage and future possibilities.

Situated next to a large city-owned lot, the property benefits from a more open setting and additional separation from neighboring homes. The home does require renovations and updates, but its generous layout, two-family configuration, and attractive price point create significant potential.

Located in Buffalo’s Genesee-Moselle area, the property is near public transportation and conveniently close to neighborhood grocery stores, restaurants, places of worship, and recreational areas including Schiller Park and Walden Park. Whether adding to an investment portfolio or creating a home while generating rental income from the second unit, 115 Goembel Ave is an opportunity worth exploring.
Offers will be reviewed Friday 10/23/26 at 12:00PM
